title: Nepal Rescuers Bore Through Tunnels to Try to Reach 900 Workers Missing After Floods
summary: The Nepal Army, which is leading rescue efforts, turned to the trapped workers more than a day after the flood, according to army officials, industry groups and private rescuers.
